Nominative-singular forms only (dyauh/dyaur), used as a proxy for the personified sky-father, since the base lemma 'div' (975 occurrences) mostly means ordinary 'sky/heaven/day' and cannot be reliably split into deity vs. common-noun senses. This is a heuristic lower bound, not a full lemma count.

Minor creator-deity ('Establisher'); distinct from the verb-root homonym dha (excluded).
